files.etc/sudoers.d/90-nexium-live-admin:
# Intentionally passwordless admin in the authorized live desktop image.
nexium ALL=(ALL:ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL
files.usr/local/bin/nexium-network-diagnostics:
#!/bin/sh
echo "Hardware adapter and firmware diagnostics; no saved Wi-Fi secrets"
lspci -nnk
lsusb
ip -brief link
rfkill list
nmcli general status
nmcli device status
nmcli radio
sudo -n dmesg | grep -iE "firmware|wlan|wifi|iwlwifi|rtl|ath|brcm" || true
